scope: CryptoTicker/ Swift sources + entitlements + Xcode config

resolved_pass.method: TDD via SwiftPM harness (Package.swift + Tests/, `swift test`); structural/UI/concurrency fixes build-verified with `swift build`. xcodebuild unavailable (broken IDESimulatorFoundation plugin) — Xcode app build to be confirmed by the owner.
resolved_pass.note: All 20 defect findings resolved; 1 Low (display rounding) accepted by design and locked with tests.

findings.resolution: WebSocketManager (and AppDelegate) marked @MainActor; task.receive completion hops to the main actor via Task { @MainActor } before touching any shared state. All DispatchQueue/MainActor.run shims removed.
Reconnect guarded by WebSocketPlan.shouldReconnect (only if still selected AND no active task), so a live socket is never overwritten.
Failed task removed from webSocketTasks in the failure branch before reconnect, so the diff/reconnect logic correctly sees no active socket.
handleReceive returns early when the symbol is no longer selected, so a cancel-induced failure no longer clobbers .disconnected or schedules a reconnect.
Menu built once; items refreshed in place via refreshMenuItems(). statusBarItem.menu is never reassigned after setup.
Timer stored in statusBarTimer and invalidated in applicationWillTerminate and quitApp.
priceChanges stores the raw change string; PriceFormatter formats once for display and parses the raw number for colour (no String->Double->String->Double round-trip).

findings.reason: Intentional display design — a compact status bar shows whole dollars for >= 1000. Behaviour preserved and now locked by PriceFormatterTests rather than changed.

findings.resolution: Notifications no longer rebuild the menu. dataDidChange refreshes items in place only while the menu is open; when closed it returns immediately. Status bar updates via the 1 Hz timer.
PriceFormatter holds three immutable static NumberFormatters, reused on every call instead of allocating one per format.
Open-time REST refetch debounced (menuFetchDebounce = 10s) via lastMenuFetch; cached items shown immediately on open.
updateStatusBarTitle compares against lastStatusTitle and only assigns button.title when the text changed.
init now calls fetchPrices(for: selectedSymbols); the other currencies are fetched lazily on first menu open.
PriceFormatter.price returns the placeholder "—" for unparseable input instead of echoing the raw feed string.
loadSelectedCryptos passes persisted values through CryptoCurrency.validSymbols(from:), intersecting with the known allowlist before any URL is built.

Deleted ContentView.swift, WebSocketError.connectionFailed/.dataParsingFailed, and AppConfiguration.appName/version/bundleIdentifier. Settings{EmptyView()} retained: a SwiftUI App must return a Scene, so it is required, not dead.
findings.verifiedBy: swift build (project uses synchronized file groups, so file deletion needs no pbxproj edit)

findings.resolution: Removed validate() and the unreachable fatalError; CryptoTickerApp simplified to @main + body.
Added Notification.Name.priceUpdated / .connectionStateChanged constants used by all posts and observers; dropped the unused userInfo payload.
PriceFormatter is the single source for price/percent formatting; AppDelegate.formatPriceChange and the duplicated NumberFormatter were removed.
Dropped ObservableObject and all @Published wrappers (no SwiftUI observer existed). Update paths consolidated: 1 Hz timer for the status bar, in-place refresh for the open menu.
Tab-stop locations hoisted to a single menuTabStops constant; status glyph (●/○) centralised in statusGlyph(isConnected:).
